title: Port all CSV seed data loading
acceptance_criteria: db/seeds.rb uses require csv and Ruby stdlib CSV (not CSV::Reader/CSV::Writer)
Helper method uses Rails.root.join for file paths
SQL injection fixed: ALL string-interpolated conditions replaced with parameterized find_by or where
set_skill_ids helper for template CSVs uses parameterized lookup
Character data loaded: ArmorData, EquipmentData, SkillData, WeaponData, ProfessionData, TemplateData
Mecha data loaded: ArmorData, MovementData, SensorData, ServoData+LevelData, ShieldData, SubassemblyData, WeaponData
completion_summary: Ported CSV seed loading: modern CSV.read/CSV.open, Rails.root.join, parameterized find_by! eliminating all SQL injection. All 13 seed models covered.
